<thought>We have the adsorption site coordinates, but the tool can auto‑select a site, so we will let it choose the default top site. I will provide the silicon slab CIF (as given in the task description) and a simple CO₂ molecule CIF that I create manually. Using the tool `add_adsorbate_to_slab_text` with a height of 2.0 Å will generate the combined structure. I will then write the resulting CIF to a file and return its path.</thought>
